```{r}
merge_bouts <- function(df, gap = 1) {
  
  df %>%
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time) %>%
    group_by(Video, Event) %>%
    mutate(
      gap_prev = Start_time - lag(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      new_group = ifelse(is.na(gap_prev) | gap_prev > gap, 1, 0),
      group_id = cumsum(new_group)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Video, Event, group_id) %>%
    summarise(
      Start_time = first(Start_time),
      `End Time` = last(`End Time`),
      Start_frame = first(Start_frame),
      End_frame = last(End_frame),
      Bout_time = `End Time` - Start_time,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(Video, Event, Start_time)
}

# -----------------------------
# Convert to MM:SS.ss
# -----------------------------
convert_mmss2 <- function(x) {
  sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
}

# -----------------------------
# Process each video
# -----------------------------
process_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  out <- df %>%
    filter(
      Video == video_name,
      Event %in% c("Exp_social", "Exp_withdraw", "Exp_freeze")
    ) %>%
    arrange(Start_time) %>%
    mutate(
      Event = dplyr::recode(Event,
        Exp_social   = "social",
        Exp_withdraw = "withdraw",
        Exp_freeze   = "freeze"
      ),
      start = convert_mmss2(Start_time),
      end   = convert_mmss2(`End Time`)
    ) %>%
    group_by(Event) %>%
    mutate(bout = row_number()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Event, bout, start, end) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Event,
      values_from = c(start, end),
      names_glue = "{Event}_{.value}",
      values_fn = list(start = min, end = max)
    )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Ensure all columns exist
  # -----------------------------
  required_cols <- c(
    "social_start","social_end",
    "withdraw_start","withdraw_end",
    "freeze_start","freeze_end"
  )
  
  for (col in required_cols) {
    if (!col %in% colnames(out)) {
      out[[col]] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Final ordering
  # -----------------------------
  out %>%
    select(
      bout,
      social_start, social_end,
      withdraw_start, withdraw_end,
      freeze_start, freeze_end
    )
}
```

```{r}
# Read workbook
wb <- loadWorkbook("Simba_0626.xlsx")

# Sheet names
sheets <- getSheetNames("Simba_0626.xlsx")

# Read each sheet into an object named lab_<sheetname>
for (sh in sheets) {
  assign(
    paste0("labo_", sh),
    read.xlsx("Simba_0626.xlsx", sheet = sh)
  )

sec_to_mmss <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
  )
}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat common bad patterns as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  # Only accept valid mm:ss or mm:ss.xx
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

add_offset_simple <- function(df, offset_mmss) {
  
  offset_sec <- time_to_sec(offset_mmss)
  
  if (is.na(offset_sec)) {
    stop("Offset could not be parsed into seconds.")
  }
  
  # ✅ UPDATED column list
  time_cols <- c(
    "social_start", "social_end",
    "freeze_start", "freeze_end",
    "withdraw_start", "withdraw_end"
  )
  
  df %>%
      mutate(
      # force these two columns to character
      approach_w = as.character(approach_w),
      approach_f = as.character(approach_f),
      across(
        any_of(time_cols),
        ~ {
          secs <- time_to_sec(.)
          
          # Guard: if entire column is NA, keep NA
          if (all(is.na(secs))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(secs)))
          
          sec_to_mmss(secs + offset_sec)
        }
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat "", "NA" as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))  # 🔴 force numeric
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl(":", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  })
  
  return(out)
}
make_summary_df <- function(df) {

  # -------------------------
  # Helper to expand rows
  # -------------------------
  expand_behavior <- function(data, approach_label, nonapproach_label) {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end))

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      start = numeric(),
      end = numeric(),
      behavior = character()
    ))
  }

  bind_rows(

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = approach_label
      ),

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = nonapproach_label
      )

  )
}

  # -------------------------
  # SOCIAL
  # -------------------------
  social_df <-
    if (all(c("social_start","social_end","approach_s") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(social_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(social_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_s)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_social", "nonapproach_social")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # WITHDRAW
  # -------------------------
  withdraw_df <-
    if (all(c("withdraw_start","withdraw_end","approach_w") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_w)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_withdraw", "nonapproach_withdraw")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # FREEZE
  # -------------------------
  freeze_df <-
    if (all(c("freeze_start","freeze_end","approach_f") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_f)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_freeze", "nonapproach_freeze")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # Combine
  # -------------------------
  res <- bind_rows(social_df, withdraw_df, freeze_df)

  if (nrow(res) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        start_time = numeric(),
        end_time   = numeric(),
        behavior   = character(),
        short_flag = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  res %>%
    mutate(
      duration = end - start,
      short_flag = as.numeric(duration <= 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(start) %>%
    select(
      start_time = start,
      end_time = end,
      behavior,
      short_flag
    )
}
```

```{r}
compute_behavior_overlap <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert lab dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  lab_bouts <- bind_rows(

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Social",
        start = time_to_sec(social_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(social_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end)
      )

  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert Boris dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  tian_bouts <- tian_df %>%
    transmute(
      type = case_when(
        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",

        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response",
          "E: I-E-avoidance"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(type),
           !is.na(start),
           !is.na(end),
           end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Matching function
  # -----------------------------
  get_matches <- function(df1, df2) {

    df1 %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        matching = any(
          df2$type == type &
            df2$start < end &
            df2$end > start
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  lab_matches  <- get_matches(lab_bouts, tian_bouts)
  tian_matches <- get_matches(tian_bouts, lab_bouts)

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
calc_metrics <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # If either scorer has no bouts, correlation is undefined
  if (nrow(lab_df) == 0 || nrow(tian_df) == 0) {
    return(list(
      corr_bout = NA_real_,
      corr_time = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  all_matches <- c(
    lab_df$matching,
    tian_df$matching
  )

  corr_bout <- mean(all_matches)

  matched_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration[lab_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration[tian_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE)

  total_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE)

  corr_time <- matched_time / total_time

  list(
    corr_bout = corr_bout,
    corr_time = corr_time
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Overall
# -----------------------------
overall <- calc_metrics(
  lab_matches,
  tian_matches
)

# -----------------------------
# Social only
# -----------------------------
social <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Social"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Social")
)

# -----------------------------
# Freeze only
# -----------------------------
freeze <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw")
)

tibble(
  Correlation_coefficient = overall$corr_bout,
  Correlation_time = overall$corr_time,

  Social_correlation_coefficient = social$corr_bout,
  Social_correlation_time = social$corr_time,

  Freeze_correlation_coefficient = freeze$corr_bout,
  Freeze_correlation_time = freeze$corr_time,

  Lab_bouts = nrow(lab_bouts),
  Boris_bouts = nrow(tian_bouts)
)
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_sec_label <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x, 2))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main processing for ONE video
# -----------------------------
process_one_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  # Safe getter: returns NA vector if column missing
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }
  
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    
    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Social"
    ),
    
    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    )
    
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
    filter(duration >= 0.5) 
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (unchanged)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# MASTER FUNCTION
# -----------------------------
summarize_all_videos <- function(df_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
      process_one_video(df_list[[name]], name)
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
process_one_video_boris <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  long_df <- df %>%
    rename(
      behavior = Behavior,
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    
    mutate(
      duration = end - start
    ) %>%
    
    filter(duration >= 0.5) %>%   # 🔑 same threshold
    
    mutate(
      interaction = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Approach",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: I-E-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Being Approached",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      type = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/no response",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/no response"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    
    filter(!is.na(interaction), !is.na(type))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (IDENTICAL structure)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Output (IDENTICAL columns)
  # -----------------------------
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}
```

```{r}
sum_trend2 <- map_dfr(
  seq_len(nrow(offset_df2)),
  function(i) {

    video <- offset_df2$Video[i]
    offset <- offset_df2$Start[i]

    df_name <- paste0("sum_", video)

    if (!exists(df_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
      warning(paste("Missing:", df_name))
      return(NULL)
    }

    df <- get(df_name)

    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        start_rel = start_time - offset,
        end_rel   = end_time - offset,
        duration  = end_rel - start_rel,

        period = case_when(
          start_rel >= 0   & start_rel < 300 ~ "first5",
          start_rel >= 300 & start_rel < 600 ~ "next5",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        ),

        type = case_when(
          str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "social",
          str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "freeze",
          TRUE ~ NA_character_
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(!is.na(period), !is.na(type))

    tibble(
  Video = video,
  Gender = offset_df2$Gender[i],

  Social_bouts_first5 =
    sum(df$type == "social" & df$period == "first5"),

  Social_time_first5 =
    sum(df$duration[df$type == "social" &
                      df$period == "first5"],
        na.rm = TRUE),

  Freeze_bouts_first5 =
    sum(df$type == "freeze" & df$period == "first5"),

  Freeze_time_first5 =
    sum(df$duration[df$type == "freeze" &
                      df$period == "first5"],
        na.rm = TRUE),

  Social_bouts_next5 =
    sum(df$type == "social" & df$period == "next5"),

  Social_time_next5 =
    sum(df$duration[df$type == "social" &
                      df$period == "next5"],
        na.rm = TRUE),

  Freeze_bouts_next5 =
    sum(df$type == "freeze" & df$period == "next5"),

  Freeze_time_next5 =
    sum(df$duration[df$type == "freeze" &
                      df$period == "next5"],
        na.rm = TRUE)
)
  }
)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_probability <- function(...,
                                      dt = 0.2,
                                      sigma = 10) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Input data
  # First 14 = Isolation
  # Second 16 = Grouped
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- list(...)

  if (length(dfs) != 30) {
    stop("Exactly 12 dataframes are required: 6 Isolation + 6 Grouped.")
  }

  group_labels <- c(
    rep("Isolation", 14),
    rep("Grouped", 16)
  )

  # Get names of input objects:
  # sum_17_59_14 -> 17_59_14
  call_names <- as.character(
    match.call(expand.dots = FALSE)$...
  )

  video_names <- sub(
    "^sum_",
    "",
    call_names
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Align copies only
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- Map(
    function(df, video_name, group_name) {

      offset <- offset_df2 %>%
        filter(Video == video_name) %>%
        pull(Start)

      if (length(offset) != 1) {
        stop("Offset not found for: ", video_name)
      }

      df %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = start_time - offset,
          end_time = end_time - offset,

          Type = case_when(
            str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
            str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),

          Group = group_name
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Type),
          end_time >= 0
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = pmax(start_time, 0)
        )

    },
    dfs,
    video_names,
    group_labels
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Common time grid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  max_time <- max(
    sapply(
      dfs,
      function(x) max(x$end_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  grid <- seq(
    0,
    max_time,
    by = dt
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian kernel
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  radius <- ceiling(4 * sigma / dt)

  kernel_x <- (-radius:radius) * dt

  kernel <- dnorm(
    kernel_x,
    sd = sigma
  )

  kernel <- kernel / sum(kernel)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian smoothing without zero-padding
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gaussian_smooth <- function(x) {

    n <- length(x)

    result <- numeric(n)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {

      idx <- (i - radius):(i + radius)

      valid <- idx >= 1 & idx <= n

      result[i] <- sum(
        x[idx[valid]] * kernel[valid]
      ) /
        sum(kernel[valid])
    }

    result
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate probability separately for each Group × Behavior
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- bind_rows(

    lapply(
      c("Isolation", "Grouped"),
      function(grp) {

        group_dfs <- dfs[
          vapply(
            dfs,
            function(x) unique(x$Group)[1] == grp,
            logical(1)
          )
        ]

        n_group_videos <- length(group_dfs)

        bind_rows(

          lapply(
            c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw"),
            function(tp) {

              occ <- matrix(
                0,
                nrow = n_group_videos,
                ncol = length(grid)
              )

              for (i in seq_along(group_dfs)) {

                bouts <- group_dfs[[i]] %>%
                  filter(Type == tp)

                if (nrow(bouts) == 0) {
                  next
                }

                for (j in seq_len(nrow(bouts))) {

                  idx <- which(
                    grid >= bouts$start_time[j] &
                    grid <= bouts$end_time[j]
                  )

                  if (length(idx) > 0) {
                    occ[i, idx] <- 1
                  }
                }
              }

              # Smooth each video separately
              occ_smooth <- t(
                apply(
                  occ,
                  1,
                  gaussian_smooth
                )
              )

              tibble(
                time = grid,
                Probability = colMeans(
                  occ_smooth,
                  na.rm = TRUE
                ),
                Behavior = tp,
                Group = grp
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Numerical protection + combined legend category
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- prob_df %>%
    mutate(
      Probability = pmin(
        pmax(Probability, 0),
        1
      ),

      Group = factor(
        Group,
        levels = c("Isolation", "Grouped")
      ),

      Behavior = factor(
        Behavior,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      ),

      # One variable controls BOTH colour and linetype.
      # This forces a single four-entry legend.
      Category = factor(
        paste(Group, Behavior, sep = "-"),
        levels = c(
          "Grouped-Social",
          "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
          "Isolation-Social",
          "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
        )
      )
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Paper-ready colours
  #
  # Social          = muted red
  # Freeze/Withdraw = muted blue
  #
  # Group is represented by line type:
  # Grouped   = dashed
  # Isolation = solid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  category_colors <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8"
  )

  category_linetypes <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "dashed",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "dashed",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "solid",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "solid"
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  prob_df,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = Probability,
    colour = Category,
    linetype = Category
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8",
      "Isolation-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze"
    ),
    name = "Group / Behavior"
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "dashed",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "dashed",
      "Isolation-Social" = "solid",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "solid"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        linetype = c(
          "dashed",
          "dashed",
          "solid",
          "solid"
        ),
        linewidth = c(
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5
        )
      )
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "IS8 Gaussian Kernel Smoothing Behavior Probability (σ = ",
      sigma,
      " s)"
    ),
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Probability"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(
      1.5,
      "cm"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
sec_to_mmss <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
  )
}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat common bad patterns as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  # Only accept valid mm:ss or mm:ss.xx
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

add_offset_simple <- function(df, offset_mmss) {
  
  offset_sec <- time_to_sec(offset_mmss)
  
  if (is.na(offset_sec)) {
    stop("Offset could not be parsed into seconds.")
  }
  
  # ✅ UPDATED column list
  time_cols <- c(
    "social_start", "social_end",
    "freeze_start", "freeze_end",
    "withdraw_start", "withdraw_end"
  )
  
  df %>%
      mutate(
      # force these two columns to character
      approach_w = as.character(approach_w),
      approach_f = as.character(approach_f),
      across(
        any_of(time_cols),
        ~ {
          secs <- time_to_sec(.)
          
          # Guard: if entire column is NA, keep NA
          if (all(is.na(secs))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(secs)))
          
          sec_to_mmss(secs + offset_sec)
        }
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat "", "NA" as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))  # 🔴 force numeric
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl(":", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  })
  
  return(out)
}
make_summary_df <- function(df) {

  # -------------------------
  # Helper to expand rows
  # -------------------------
  expand_behavior <- function(data, approach_label, nonapproach_label) {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end))

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      start = numeric(),
      end = numeric(),
      behavior = character()
    ))
  }

  bind_rows(

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = approach_label
      ),

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = nonapproach_label
      )

  )
}

  # -------------------------
  # SOCIAL
  # -------------------------
  social_df <-
    if (all(c("social_start","social_end","approach_s") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(social_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(social_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_s)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_social", "nonapproach_social")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # WITHDRAW
  # -------------------------
  withdraw_df <-
    if (all(c("withdraw_start","withdraw_end","approach_w") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_w)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_withdraw", "nonapproach_withdraw")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # FREEZE
  # -------------------------
  freeze_df <-
    if (all(c("freeze_start","freeze_end","approach_f") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_f)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_freeze", "nonapproach_freeze")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # Combine
  # -------------------------
  res <- bind_rows(social_df, withdraw_df, freeze_df)

  if (nrow(res) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        start_time = numeric(),
        end_time   = numeric(),
        behavior   = character(),
        short_flag = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  res %>%
    mutate(
      duration = end - start,
      short_flag = as.numeric(duration <= 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(start) %>%
    select(
      start_time = start,
      end_time = end,
      behavior,
      short_flag
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  sapply(x, function(z) {

    if (is.na(z) || trimws(z) == "") {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    parts <- strsplit(z, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

    if (length(parts) == 3) {
      as.numeric(parts[1]) * 3600 +
        as.numeric(parts[2]) * 60 +
        as.numeric(parts[3])
    } else if (length(parts) == 2) {
      as.numeric(parts[1]) * 60 +
        as.numeric(parts[2])
    } else {
      as.numeric(z)
    }
  })
}
compute_behavior_overlap <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert lab dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  lab_bouts <- bind_rows(

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Social",
        start = time_to_sec(social_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(social_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end)
      )

  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert Boris dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  tian_bouts <- tian_df %>%
    transmute(
      type = case_when(
        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",

        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-avoidance"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(type),
           !is.na(start),
           !is.na(end),
           end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Matching function
  # -----------------------------
  get_matches <- function(df1, df2) {

    df1 %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        matching = any(
          df2$type == type &
            df2$start < end &
            df2$end > start
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  lab_matches  <- get_matches(lab_bouts, tian_bouts)
  tian_matches <- get_matches(tian_bouts, lab_bouts)

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
calc_metrics <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # If either scorer has no bouts, correlation is undefined
  if (nrow(lab_df) == 0 || nrow(tian_df) == 0) {
    return(list(
      corr_bout = NA_real_,
      corr_time = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  all_matches <- c(
    lab_df$matching,
    tian_df$matching
  )

  corr_bout <- mean(all_matches)

  matched_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration[lab_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration[tian_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE)

  total_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE)

  corr_time <- matched_time / total_time

  list(
    corr_bout = corr_bout,
    corr_time = corr_time
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Overall
# -----------------------------
overall <- calc_metrics(
  lab_matches,
  tian_matches
)

# -----------------------------
# Social only
# -----------------------------
social <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Social"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Social")
)

# -----------------------------
# Freeze only
# -----------------------------
freeze <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw")
)

tibble(
  Correlation_coefficient = overall$corr_bout,
  Correlation_time = overall$corr_time,

  Social_correlation_coefficient = social$corr_bout,
  Social_correlation_time = social$corr_time,

  Freeze_correlation_coefficient = freeze$corr_bout,
  Freeze_correlation_time = freeze$corr_time,

  Lab_bouts = nrow(lab_bouts),
  Boris_bouts = nrow(tian_bouts)
)
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),

  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)
```

```{r}
    ),

  ) %>%

      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%

      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),

      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    ),
    duration = end - start   # ← ADD THIS
  )
# Social colors

  "Approach" = "green",
  "Being Approached" = "#FF10F0"
```

```{r}
# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "13_54_29 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "13_54_29 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_timeline <- function(df, bar_width = 2) {

  video_name <- sub("^sum_", "", deparse(substitute(df)))

  offset <- offset_df %>%
    filter(Video == video_name) %>%
    pull(Start)

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = start_time - offset,
      end_time = end_time - offset,
      duration = end_time - start_time,
      duration = ifelse(duration > 15, 15, duration),
      Type = case_when(
        str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
        str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Type),
      start_time <= 600,
      end_time >= 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = pmax(start_time, 0),
      start_time = start_time / 60,
      Type = factor(
        Type,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = start_time,
             y = duration)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(fill = Type),
      width = bar_width / 60
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Social = "red",
        `Freeze/Withdraw` = "blue"
      ),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
) +
coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, 10)
) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15),
      labels = c("3", "6", "9", "12", "15+"),
      limits = c(0, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(video_name, "Behavior Density Plot"),
      x = "Time (min)",
      y = "Bout Duration (s)",
      fill = "Behavior"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_sec_label <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x, 2))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main processing for ONE video
# -----------------------------
process_one_video <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  # Safe getter: returns NA vector if column missing
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }
  
  long_df <- bind_rows(
    
    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Social"
    ),
    
    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    )
    
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start) 
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (unchanged)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# MASTER FUNCTION
# -----------------------------
summarize_all_videos <- function(df_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
      process_one_video(df_list[[name]], name)
    })
  )
}

  "14_08_30" = lab_14_08_30,
  "14_10_39" = lab_14_10_39,
  "14_23_28" = lab_14_23_28,
  "14_25_44" = lab_14_25_44
)
```

```{r}
process_one_video_boris <- function(df, video_name) {
  
  long_df <- df %>%
    rename(
      behavior = Behavior,
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    
    mutate(
      duration = end - start
    )  %>%  
    
    mutate(
      interaction = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Approach",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: I-E-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Being Approached",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      
      type = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",
        
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    
    filter(!is.na(interaction), !is.na(type))
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics (IDENTICAL structure)
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
    
    approach_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach"),
    approach_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    approach_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    approach_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"),
    ba_social_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
    ba_fw_time  = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
    
    short_bouts = sum(long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
  
  # -----------------------------
  # Output (IDENTICAL columns)
  # -----------------------------
  tibble(
    Video = video_name,
    
    `Approach bouts` = summary$approach_bouts,
    `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
    `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
    `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
    
    `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
    `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
    
    `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
    `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
    
    `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
    `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
    
    `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
    `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time),
    
    `<=1 seconds` = summary$short_bouts
  )
}
```

```{r}
sec_to_mmss <- function(x) {
  ifelse(
    is.na(x),
    NA_character_,
    sprintf("%02d:%05.2f", floor(x / 60), x %% 60)
  )
}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat common bad patterns as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  # Only accept valid mm:ss or mm:ss.xx
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    if (length(p) < 2) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

add_offset_simple <- function(df, offset_mmss) {
  
  offset_sec <- time_to_sec(offset_mmss)
  
  if (is.na(offset_sec)) {
    stop("Offset could not be parsed into seconds.")
  }
  
  # ✅ UPDATED column list
  time_cols <- c(
    "social_start", "social_end",
    "freeze_start", "freeze_end",
    "withdraw_start", "withdraw_end"
  )
  
  df %>%
      mutate(
      # force these two columns to character
      approach_w = as.character(approach_w),
      approach_f = as.character(approach_f),
      across(
        any_of(time_cols),
        ~ {
          secs <- time_to_sec(.)
          
          # Guard: if entire column is NA, keep NA
          if (all(is.na(secs))) return(rep(NA_character_, length(secs)))
          
          sec_to_mmss(secs + offset_sec)
        }
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  
  # Treat "", "NA" as NA
  x[x %in% c("", "NA")] <- NA
  
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))  # 🔴 force numeric
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl(":", x)
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  
  out[valid] <- sapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  })
  
  return(out)
}
make_summary_df <- function(df) {

  # -------------------------
  # Helper to expand rows
  # -------------------------
  expand_behavior <- function(data, approach_label, nonapproach_label) {

  data <- data %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end))

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      start = numeric(),
      end = numeric(),
      behavior = character()
    ))
  }

  bind_rows(

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("a", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = approach_label
      ),

    data %>%
      filter(flag %in% c("n", "b")) %>%
      transmute(
        start,
        end,
        behavior = nonapproach_label
      )

  )
}

  # -------------------------
  # SOCIAL
  # -------------------------
  social_df <-
    if (all(c("social_start","social_end","approach_s") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(social_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(social_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_s)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_social", "nonapproach_social")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # WITHDRAW
  # -------------------------
  withdraw_df <-
    if (all(c("withdraw_start","withdraw_end","approach_w") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_w)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_withdraw", "nonapproach_withdraw")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # FREEZE
  # -------------------------
  freeze_df <-
    if (all(c("freeze_start","freeze_end","approach_f") %in% names(df))) {
      df %>%
        transmute(
          start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
          end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end),
          flag  = as.character(approach_f)
        ) %>%
        expand_behavior("approach_freeze", "nonapproach_freeze")
    } else {
      tibble(start=numeric(), end=numeric(), behavior=character())
    }

  # -------------------------
  # Combine
  # -------------------------
  res <- bind_rows(social_df, withdraw_df, freeze_df)

  if (nrow(res) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble(
        start_time = numeric(),
        end_time   = numeric(),
        behavior   = character(),
        short_flag = numeric()
      )
    )
  }

  res %>%
    mutate(
      duration = end - start,
      short_flag = as.numeric(duration <= 1)
    ) %>%
    arrange(start) %>%
    select(
      start_time = start,
      end_time = end,
      behavior,
      short_flag
    )
}
```

```{r}
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)

  sapply(x, function(z) {

    if (is.na(z) || trimws(z) == "") {
      return(NA_real_)
    }

    parts <- strsplit(z, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]

    if (length(parts) == 3) {
      as.numeric(parts[1]) * 3600 +
        as.numeric(parts[2]) * 60 +
        as.numeric(parts[3])
    } else if (length(parts) == 2) {
      as.numeric(parts[1]) * 60 +
        as.numeric(parts[2])
    } else {
      as.numeric(z)
    }
  })
}
compute_behavior_overlap <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert lab dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  lab_bouts <- bind_rows(

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Social",
        start = time_to_sec(social_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(social_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(withdraw_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(withdraw_end)
      ),

    lab_df %>%
      transmute(
        type = "Freeze/Withdraw",
        start = time_to_sec(freeze_start),
        end   = time_to_sec(freeze_end)
      )

  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Convert Boris dataframe
  # -----------------------------
  tian_bouts <- tian_df %>%
    transmute(
      type = case_when(
        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",

        Behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-avoidance"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(type),
           !is.na(start),
           !is.na(end),
           end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Matching function
  # -----------------------------
  get_matches <- function(df1, df2) {

    df1 %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        matching = any(
          df2$type == type &
            df2$start < end &
            df2$end > start
        )
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  }

  lab_matches  <- get_matches(lab_bouts, tian_bouts)
  tian_matches <- get_matches(tian_bouts, lab_bouts)

# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
# -----------------------------
# Helper function
# -----------------------------
calc_metrics <- function(lab_df, tian_df) {

  # If either scorer has no bouts, correlation is undefined
  if (nrow(lab_df) == 0 || nrow(tian_df) == 0) {
    return(list(
      corr_bout = NA_real_,
      corr_time = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  all_matches <- c(
    lab_df$matching,
    tian_df$matching
  )

  corr_bout <- mean(all_matches)

  matched_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration[lab_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration[tian_df$matching], na.rm = TRUE)

  total_time <-
    sum(lab_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE) +
    sum(tian_df$duration, na.rm = TRUE)

  corr_time <- matched_time / total_time

  list(
    corr_bout = corr_bout,
    corr_time = corr_time
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# Overall
# -----------------------------
overall <- calc_metrics(
  lab_matches,
  tian_matches
)

# -----------------------------
# Social only
# -----------------------------
social <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Social"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Social")
)

# -----------------------------
# Freeze only
# -----------------------------
freeze <- calc_metrics(
  filter(lab_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  filter(tian_matches, type == "Freeze/Withdraw")
)

tibble(
  Correlation_coefficient = overall$corr_bout,
  Correlation_time = overall$corr_time,

  Social_correlation_coefficient = social$corr_bout,
  Social_correlation_time = social$corr_time,

  Freeze_correlation_coefficient = freeze$corr_bout,
  Freeze_correlation_time = freeze$corr_time,

  Lab_bouts = nrow(lab_bouts),
  Boris_bouts = nrow(tian_bouts)
)
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "14_30_35 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "14_30_35 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table
```

```{r}
    category = case_when(

      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(

    ),

  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "14_59_45 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "14_59_45 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table

plot_social_combined
```

```{r}
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "SimBA"
  )

tian_adj <- sum_tian16_27_03 %>%
  rename(
    behavior = Behavior,
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

    ),

      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),

      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    ),

  )

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),

)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(

)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "17_08_59 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "17_08_59 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_timeline <- function(df, bar_width = 2) {

  video_name <- sub("^sum_", "", deparse(substitute(df)))

  offset <- offset_df %>%
    filter(Video == video_name) %>%
    pull(Start)

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = start_time - offset,
      end_time = end_time - offset,
      duration = end_time - start_time,
      duration = ifelse(duration > 15, 15, duration),
      Type = case_when(
        str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
        str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Type),
      start_time <= 600,
      end_time >= 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = pmax(start_time, 0),
      start_time = start_time / 60,
      Type = factor(
        Type,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = start_time,
             y = duration)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(fill = Type),
      width = bar_width / 60
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Social = "red",
        `Freeze/Withdraw` = "blue"
      ),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
) +
coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, 10)
) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15),
      labels = c("3", "6", "9", "12", "15+"),
      limits = c(0, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(video_name, "Behavior Density Plot"),
      x = "Time (min)",
      y = "Bout Duration (s)",
      fill = "Behavior"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
}
```
