```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_sec_label <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x, 2))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main processing for ONE video
# -----------------------------
process_one_video <- function(df, video_name) {

  # Safe getter: returns NA vector if column missing
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }

  long_df <- bind_rows(

    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Social"
    ),

    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),

    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    )

  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
  social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  short_social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social" & long_df$duration <= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
  short_freeze_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw" & long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
)

tibble(
  Video = video_name,
  `Social bouts` = summary$social_bouts,
  `Social <= 0.5s` = summary$short_social_bouts,
  `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
  `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
  `Freeze/Withdraw <= 1s` = summary$short_freeze_bouts,
  `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
  `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
  `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
  `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
  `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
  `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
  `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
  `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
  `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time)
)

}

summarize_all_videos <- function(df_list) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
      process_one_video(df_list[[name]], name)
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
process_one_video_boris <- function(df, video_name) {

  long_df <- df %>%
    rename(
      behavior = Behavior,
      start = `Start (s)`,
      end   = `Stop (s)`
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(
      duration = end - start
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      interaction = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Approach",

        behavior %in% c(
          "E: I-E-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Being Approached",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),

      type = case_when(
        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-social behavior",
          "E: I-E-social behavior"
        ) ~ "Social",

        behavior %in% c(
          "E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal",
          "E: I-E-avoidance",
          "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal"
        ) ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",

        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(interaction), !is.na(type))

  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
  social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  short_social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social" & long_df$duration <= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
  short_freeze_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw" & long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
)

tibble(
  Video = video_name,
  `Social bouts` = summary$social_bouts,
  `Social <= 0.5s` = summary$short_social_bouts,
  `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
  `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
  `Freeze <= 1s` = summary$short_freeze_bouts,
  `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
  `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
  `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
  `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
  `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
  `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
  `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
  `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
  `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time)
)
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_probability <- function(...,
                                      dt = 0.2,
                                      sigma = 10) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Input data
  # First 6 = Isolation
  # Second 6 = Grouped
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- list(...)

  if (length(dfs) != 12) {
    stop("Exactly 12 dataframes are required: 6 Isolation + 6 Grouped.")
  }

  group_labels <- c(
    rep("Isolation", 6),
    rep("Grouped", 6)
  )

  # Get names of input objects:
  # sum_17_59_14 -> 17_59_14
  call_names <- as.character(
    match.call(expand.dots = FALSE)$...
  )

  video_names <- sub(
    "^sum_",
    "",
    call_names
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Align copies only
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- Map(
    function(df, video_name, group_name) {

      offset <- offset_df %>%
        filter(Video == video_name) %>%
        pull(Start)

      if (length(offset) != 1) {
        stop("Offset not found for: ", video_name)
      }

      df %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = start_time - offset,
          end_time = end_time - offset,

          Type = case_when(
            str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
            str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),

          Group = group_name
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Type),
          end_time >= 0
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = pmax(start_time, 0)
        )

    },
    dfs,
    video_names,
    group_labels
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Common time grid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  max_time <- max(
    sapply(
      dfs,
      function(x) max(x$end_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  grid <- seq(
    0,
    max_time,
    by = dt
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian kernel
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  radius <- ceiling(4 * sigma / dt)

  kernel_x <- (-radius:radius) * dt

  kernel <- dnorm(
    kernel_x,
    sd = sigma
  )

  kernel <- kernel / sum(kernel)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian smoothing without zero-padding
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gaussian_smooth <- function(x) {

    n <- length(x)

    result <- numeric(n)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {

      idx <- (i - radius):(i + radius)

      valid <- idx >= 1 & idx <= n

      result[i] <- sum(
        x[idx[valid]] * kernel[valid]
      ) /
        sum(kernel[valid])
    }

    result
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate probability separately for each Group × Behavior
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- bind_rows(

    lapply(
      c("Isolation", "Grouped"),
      function(grp) {

        group_dfs <- dfs[
          vapply(
            dfs,
            function(x) unique(x$Group)[1] == grp,
            logical(1)
          )
        ]

        n_group_videos <- length(group_dfs)

        bind_rows(

          lapply(
            c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw"),
            function(tp) {

              occ <- matrix(
                0,
                nrow = n_group_videos,
                ncol = length(grid)
              )

              for (i in seq_along(group_dfs)) {

                bouts <- group_dfs[[i]] %>%
                  filter(Type == tp)

                if (nrow(bouts) == 0) {
                  next
                }

                for (j in seq_len(nrow(bouts))) {

                  idx <- which(
                    grid >= bouts$start_time[j] &
                    grid <= bouts$end_time[j]
                  )

                  if (length(idx) > 0) {
                    occ[i, idx] <- 1
                  }
                }
              }

              # Smooth each video separately
              occ_smooth <- t(
                apply(
                  occ,
                  1,
                  gaussian_smooth
                )
              )

              tibble(
                time = grid,
                Probability = colMeans(
                  occ_smooth,
                  na.rm = TRUE
                ),
                Behavior = tp,
                Group = grp
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Numerical protection + combined legend category
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- prob_df %>%
    mutate(
      Probability = pmin(
        pmax(Probability, 0),
        1
      ),

      Group = factor(
        Group,
        levels = c("Isolation", "Grouped")
      ),

      Behavior = factor(
        Behavior,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      ),

      # One variable controls BOTH colour and linetype.
      # This forces a single four-entry legend.
      Category = factor(
        paste(Group, Behavior, sep = "-"),
        levels = c(
          "Grouped-Social",
          "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
          "Isolation-Social",
          "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
        )
      )
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Paper-ready colours
  #
  # Social          = muted red
  # Freeze/Withdraw = muted blue
  #
  # Group is represented by line type:
  # Grouped   = dashed
  # Isolation = solid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  category_colors <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8"
  )

  category_linetypes <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "dashed",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "dashed",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "solid",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "solid"
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  prob_df,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = Probability,
    colour = Category,
    linetype = Category
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8",
      "Isolation-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze"
    ),
    name = "Group / Behavior"
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "dashed",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "dashed",
      "Isolation-Social" = "solid",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "solid"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        linetype = c(
          "dashed",
          "dashed",
          "solid",
          "solid"
        ),
        linewidth = c(
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5
        )
      )
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "IS14 Group1 Gaussian Kernel Smoothing Behavior Probability (σ = ",
      sigma,
      " s)"
    ),
    x = "Time (s)",
    y = "Probability"
  ) +

  theme_minimal() +

  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 18
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 16
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 14
    ),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(
      1.5,
      "cm"
    )
  )
}

  sum_14_45_07,
```

```{r}
simba_adj <- sum_13_54_20 %>%
  rename(
    start = start_time,
    end   = end_time
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior %in% c("approach_social") ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("approach_withdraw", "approach_freeze") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "SimBA"
  )

tian_adj <- sum_tian13_54_20 %>%
  rename(
    behavior = Behavior,
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "Human score with Boris"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), start != end)
plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(
      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # Interaction type (for color consistency)
    interaction = case_when(
      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    ),
    duration = end - start   # ← ADD THIS
  )
# Social colors
social_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "green",
  "Being Approached" = "#FF10F0"
)

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "13_54_20 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "13_54_20 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table

plot_social_combined
```

```{r}
    ),

  ) %>%

plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%

    ),

    ),

  )
# Social colors

  "Approach" = "green",
```

```{r}
# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "14_39_00 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "14_39_00 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
    category = case_when(

      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

    ),
    source = "Human score with Boris"
  ) %>%

plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%
  mutate(
    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(

    ),
```

```{r}
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
plot_social <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "15_23_34 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(
  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Freeze/Withdraw"),
  "15_23_34 Freeze / Withdraw Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  fw_colors
)

# -----------------------------
# Count table function
# -----------------------------
social_counts <- plot_df %>%
  filter(behavior_type == "Social") %>%
  mutate(duration = end - start) %>%
  group_by(source, interaction) %>%
  summarise(
    bouts = n(),
    time  = sum(duration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = interaction,
    values_from = c(bouts, time),
    values_fill = list(bouts = 0, time = 0)
  ) %>%
  {
    df <- .
    for (col in c(
      "bouts_Approach", "time_Approach",
      "bouts_Being Approached", "time_Being Approached"
    )) {
      if (!col %in% names(df)) df[[col]] <- 0
    }
    df
  } %>%
  arrange(factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"))) %>%
  mutate(
    Approach = paste0(bouts_Approach, " (", sec_to_mmss(time_Approach), ")"),
    `Being Approached` = paste0(
      .data[["bouts_Being Approached"]],
      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)

table_grob_social <- tableGrob(
  social_counts,
  rows = NULL,
  theme = ttheme_minimal(base_size = 12)
)

plot_social_combined <- plot_social / table_grob_social +
  plot_layout(heights = c(3, 1))  # plot bigger than table

plot_social_combined

  ) %>%
```

```{r}
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_freeze", "nonapproach_withdraw") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("nonapproach_social") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",
      
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    source = "SimBA"
  )

tian_adj <- sum_tian16_58_53 %>%
  rename(
    behavior = Behavior,
    start = `Start (s)`,
    end   = `Stop (s)`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      behavior == "E: E-I-social behavior" ~ "Approach->Social Interaction",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: E-I-freezing/withdrawal") ~ "Approach->Freeze/Withdraw",
      
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-avoidance", "E: I-E-freezing/withdrawal", "I: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Freeze/Withdraw",
      behavior %in% c("E: I-E-social behavior") ~ "Being Approached->Social Interaction",

    ),

plot_df <- bind_rows(simba_adj, tian_adj) %>%

    source = factor(source, levels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris")),
    
    # Behavior type (for splitting plots)
    behavior_type = case_when(
      grepl("Social", category) ~ "Social",
      TRUE ~ "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    
    # Interaction type (for color consistency)
    interaction = case_when(
      grepl("^Approach", category) ~ "Approach",
      grepl("^Being Approached", category) ~ "Being Approached"
    ),
    duration = end - start   # ← ADD THIS
  )

)

# Freeze/Withdraw colors (keep original)
fw_colors <- c(
  "Approach" = "#1f77b4",
  "Being Approached" = "#d62728"
)
plot_behavior <- function(df, title_text, color_map) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    bind_rows(
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("SimBA", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      ),
      data.frame(
        start = NA, end = NA,
        interaction = NA,
        source = factor("Human score with Boris", levels = c("SimBA","Human score with Boris"))
      )
    )
  
  ggplot(df) +
    geom_rect(
      aes(
        xmin = start / 60,
        xmax = end / 60,
        ymin = as.numeric(source) - 0.35,
        ymax = as.numeric(source) + 0.35,
        fill = interaction
      ),
      alpha = 0.85,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL,
      breaks = 1:2,
      labels = c("SimBA", "Human score with Boris"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      name = "Time (minutes)",
      limits = c(1.5, 12),
      breaks = seq(2, 12, by = 1),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map, na.translate = FALSE) +
    
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      fill = "Interaction"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
      aspect.ratio = 0.15,
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

  plot_df %>% filter(behavior_type == "Social"),
  "16_58_53 Social Behavior: SimBA vs Human Score",
  social_colors
)

plot_fw <- plot_behavior(

)

      " (",
      sec_to_mmss(.data[["time_Being Approached"]]),
      ")"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(source, Approach, `Being Approached`)
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_timeline <- function(df, bar_width = 2) {

  video_name <- sub("^sum_", "", deparse(substitute(df)))

  offset <- offset_df2 %>%
    filter(Video == video_name) %>%
    pull(Start)

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = start_time - offset,
      end_time = end_time - offset,
      duration = end_time - start_time,
      duration = ifelse(duration > 15, 15, duration),
      Type = case_when(
        str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
        str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(Type),
      start_time <= 600,
      end_time >= 0
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      start_time = pmax(start_time, 0),
      start_time = start_time / 60,
      Type = factor(
        Type,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      )
    )

  ggplot(plot_df,
         aes(x = start_time,
             y = duration)) +
    geom_col(
      aes(fill = Type),
      width = bar_width / 60
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        Social = "red",
        `Freeze/Withdraw` = "blue"
      ),
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10)
) +
coord_cartesian(
  xlim = c(0, 10)
) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(3, 6, 9, 12, 15),
      labels = c("3", "6", "9", "12", "15+"),
      limits = c(0, 15)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste(video_name, "Behavior Density Plot"),
      x = "Time (min)",
      y = "Bout Duration (s)",
      fill = "Behavior"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
      axis.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      legend.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14)
    )
}
```

```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Helpers
# -----------------------------
time_to_sec <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "NA:000NA")] <- NA
  
  valid <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?$", x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  
  parts <- strsplit(x[valid], ":")
  out[valid] <- vapply(parts, function(p) {
    as.numeric(p[1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[2])
  }, numeric(1))
  
  out
}

sec_to_sec_label <- function(x) {
  paste0(round(x, 2))
}

# -----------------------------
# Main processing for ONE video
# -----------------------------
process_one_video <- function(df, video_name) {

  # Safe getter: returns NA vector if column missing
  get_col <- function(data, col) {
    if (col %in% names(data)) data[[col]] else rep(NA, nrow(data))
  }

  long_df <- bind_rows(

    # --- SOCIAL ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "social_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_s") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Social"
    ),

    # --- WITHDRAW ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "withdraw_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_w") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),

    # --- FREEZE ---
    tibble(
      start = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_start")),
      end   = time_to_sec(get_col(df, "freeze_end")),
      interaction = ifelse(get_col(df, "approach_f") == "a", "Approach", "Being Approached"),
      type = "Freeze/Withdraw"
    )

  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(start), !is.na(end), end > start) %>%
    mutate(duration = end - start)

  # -----------------------------
  # Metrics
  # -----------------------------
  summary <- list(
  social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach"], na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  approach_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Approach" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_social_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Social"], na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_bouts = sum(long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw", na.rm = TRUE),
  ba_fw_time = sum(long_df$duration[long_df$interaction == "Being Approached" & long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw"], na.rm = TRUE),
  short_social_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Social" & long_df$duration <= 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
  short_freeze_bouts = sum(long_df$type == "Freeze/Withdraw" & long_df$duration <= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
)

tibble(
  Video = video_name,
  `Social bouts` = summary$social_bouts,
  `Social <= 0.5s` = summary$short_social_bouts,
  `Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$social_time),
  `Freeze/Withdraw bouts` = summary$fw_bouts,
  `Freeze/Withdraw <= 1s` = summary$short_freeze_bouts,
  `Freeze/Withdraw time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$fw_time),
  `Approach Social bouts` = summary$approach_social_bouts,
  `Approach Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_social_time),
  `Approach Freeze bouts` = summary$approach_fw_bouts,
  `Approach Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$approach_fw_time),
  `Being Approached Social bouts` = summary$ba_social_bouts,
  `Being Approached Social time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_social_time),
  `Being Approached Freeze bouts` = summary$ba_fw_bouts,
  `Being Approached Freeze time` = sec_to_sec_label(summary$ba_fw_time)
)

}

# -----------------------------
# MASTER FUNCTION
# -----------------------------
summarize_all_videos <- function(df_list) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
      process_one_video(df_list[[name]], name)
    })
  )
}

# -----------------------------
# MASTER FUNCTION

summarize_all_videos <- function(df_list) {
  
  bind_rows(
    lapply(names(df_list), function(name) {
      process_one_video(df_list[[name]], name)
    })
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_behavior_probability <- function(...,
                                      dt = 0.2,
                                      sigma = 10) {

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Input data
  # First 6 = Isolation
  # Second 6 = Grouped
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- list(...)

  if (length(dfs) != 25) {
    stop("Exactly 25 dataframes are required: 13 Isolation + 12 Grouped.")
  }

  group_labels <- c(
    rep("Isolation", 13),
    rep("Grouped", 12)
  )

  # Get names of input objects:
  # sum_17_59_14 -> 17_59_14
  call_names <- as.character(
    match.call(expand.dots = FALSE)$...
  )

  video_names <- sub(
    "^sum_",
    "",
    call_names
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Align copies only
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  dfs <- Map(
    function(df, video_name, group_name) {

      offset <- offset_df3 %>%
        filter(Video == video_name) %>%
        pull(Start)

      if (length(offset) != 1) {
        stop("Offset not found for: ", video_name)
      }

      df %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = start_time - offset,
          end_time = end_time - offset,

          Type = case_when(
            str_detect(behavior, "social") ~ "Social",
            str_detect(behavior, "freeze|withdraw") ~ "Freeze/Withdraw",
            TRUE ~ NA_character_
          ),

          Group = group_name
        ) %>%
        filter(
          !is.na(Type),
          end_time >= 0
        ) %>%
        mutate(
          start_time = pmax(start_time, 0)
        )

    },
    dfs,
    video_names,
    group_labels
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Common time grid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  max_time <- max(
    sapply(
      dfs,
      function(x) max(x$end_time, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  )

  grid <- seq(
    0,
    max_time,
    by = dt
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian kernel
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  radius <- ceiling(4 * sigma / dt)

  kernel_x <- (-radius:radius) * dt

  kernel <- dnorm(
    kernel_x,
    sd = sigma
  )

  kernel <- kernel / sum(kernel)

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gaussian smoothing without zero-padding
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  gaussian_smooth <- function(x) {

    n <- length(x)

    result <- numeric(n)

    for (i in seq_len(n)) {

      idx <- (i - radius):(i + radius)

      valid <- idx >= 1 & idx <= n

      result[i] <- sum(
        x[idx[valid]] * kernel[valid]
      ) /
        sum(kernel[valid])
    }

    result
  }

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Calculate probability separately for each Group × Behavior
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- bind_rows(

    lapply(
      c("Isolation", "Grouped"),
      function(grp) {

        group_dfs <- dfs[
          vapply(
            dfs,
            function(x) unique(x$Group)[1] == grp,
            logical(1)
          )
        ]

        n_group_videos <- length(group_dfs)

        bind_rows(

          lapply(
            c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw"),
            function(tp) {

              occ <- matrix(
                0,
                nrow = n_group_videos,
                ncol = length(grid)
              )

              for (i in seq_along(group_dfs)) {

                bouts <- group_dfs[[i]] %>%
                  filter(Type == tp)

                if (nrow(bouts) == 0) {
                  next
                }

                for (j in seq_len(nrow(bouts))) {

                  idx <- which(
                    grid >= bouts$start_time[j] &
                    grid <= bouts$end_time[j]
                  )

                  if (length(idx) > 0) {
                    occ[i, idx] <- 1
                  }
                }
              }

              # Smooth each video separately
              occ_smooth <- t(
                apply(
                  occ,
                  1,
                  gaussian_smooth
                )
              )

              tibble(
                time = grid,
                Probability = colMeans(
                  occ_smooth,
                  na.rm = TRUE
                ),
                Behavior = tp,
                Group = grp
              )
            }
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Numerical protection + combined legend category
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  prob_df <- prob_df %>%
    mutate(
      Probability = pmin(
        pmax(Probability, 0),
        1
      ),

      Group = factor(
        Group,
        levels = c("Isolation", "Grouped")
      ),

      Behavior = factor(
        Behavior,
        levels = c("Social", "Freeze/Withdraw")
      ),

      # One variable controls BOTH colour and linetype.
      # This forces a single four-entry legend.
      Category = factor(
        paste(Group, Behavior, sep = "-"),
        levels = c(
          "Grouped-Social",
          "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
          "Isolation-Social",
          "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
        )
      )
    )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Paper-ready colours
  #
  # Social          = muted red
  # Freeze/Withdraw = muted blue
  #
  # Group is represented by line type:
  # Grouped   = dashed
  # Isolation = solid
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

  category_colors <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "#B23A48",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "#3B6EA8"
  )

  category_linetypes <- c(
    "Grouped-Social" =
      "dashed",

    "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "dashed",

    "Isolation-Social" =
      "solid",

    "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" =
      "solid"
  )

  # ------------------------------------------------------------
  # Plot
  # ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  prob_df,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = Probability,
    colour = Category,
    linetype = Category
  )
) +

  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1.5
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8",
      "Isolation-Social" = "#B23A48",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "#3B6EA8"
    ),
    breaks = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Grouped-Social",
      "Grouped-Freeze",
      "Isolation-Social",
      "Isolation-Freeze"
    ),
    name = "Group / Behavior"
  ) +

  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c(
      "Grouped-Social" = "dashed",
      "Grouped-Freeze/Withdraw" = "dashed",
      "Isolation-Social" = "solid",
      "Isolation-Freeze/Withdraw" = "solid"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        linetype = c(
          "dashed",
          "dashed",
          "solid",
          "solid"
        ),
        linewidth = c(
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5,
          1.5
        )
      )
    )
  ) +

  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, 1)
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent(
      accuracy = 1
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    title = paste0(
      "IS14 Gaussian Kernel Smoothing Behavior Probability (σ = ",

    ),

  ) +

    ),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(

    )
  )
```
